name_en: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Your family gets free (cashless) hospital care up to Rs 5 lakh a year at listed government and private hospitals.

other: You must live in Tamil Nadu.
Your name must be on the family (ration) card.
The family includes the head, spouse, children and dependent parents.

documents: Income certificate from the VAO or revenue office
Self-declaration from the head of the family
how_to_apply: Get an income certificate from the Village Administrative Officer. Take your Aadhaar, ration card and income certificate to the enrolment centre. Show them to the kiosk operator. Give your fingerprint, photo and eye scan. You will get an e-card.
where_to_apply: CMCHIS enrolment centre (kiosk); details on cmchistn.com

evidence.quote: provides coverage up to Rs. 5,00,000/- per family, per year on a floater basis
their family's annual income should be less than Rs.1,20,000/- per annum
Non-residents of Tamil Nadu are not eligible for this scheme.
the applicant's name must be present in the family card
the definition of family includes the eligible member, their legal spouse, their children, and their dependent parents
Income certificate from the Village Administrative Officer/Revenue authorities
Self-declaration from the head of the family
Obtain an income certificate from the Village Administrative Officer or Revenue authorities.
Present your documents to the kiosk operator for verification.
Provide your biometric details such as fingerprints, photograph, and eye scan.
Your details will be verified and the e-card will be issued to you.
